notes.title: New Game: Tales of Tuscany
notes.content:
Hello Rhapsodogs! I'm extremely excited to announce that I've just revealed a brand new RPG that takes place in the world of Athenian Rhapsody, called [b]Tales of Tuscany[/b]. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3334170/Tales_of_Tuscany/]Please wishlist the game right here, then come back and read the rest[/url]!

Tales of Tuscany is not a direct sequel, but still carries over lots of lore, characters, and elements you loved from Athenian Rhapsody in a new, updated format. I tried my best to accelerate everything you loved in AR and also improve upon the game's shortcomings, and the best way to do this was to rip up and rework the engine a bit! Improvements include...
[list]
[*] An infinite inventory seperated by categories (Weapons, Armor, Food, Stuff)
[*] A faster protagonist + an ACTION button that lets you destroy the world around you and interact with objects/characters in new ways
[*] The ability to add nearly every opponent to your party, with more BURST skills that are balanced/defensive so that no follower is useless in a pacifist run
[*] A more in-depth RPG system, and battles that aren't based on reaching a turn-limit
[*] More creative and well-programmed REACT minigames, minigames out of battle, and QOL options
[*] Character customization and your very own Village where you will progressively unlock interactions, customizations, cool buffs, and more!
[*] Shiny hunting
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40954853/9ea853dca1cbfa831adcc220d5ba71d97e134356.gif[/img]

I hope you are as excited to see this as I am to reveal it - please wishlist it, and stay tuned for what comes next!

notes.title: Plush Launch + New DLC Event
notes.content:
[h2]Rhapsodogs, you're in for a MAJOR treat!!![/h2]

[b][u]What's New:[/u][/b]
- The Goober's Picnic Event has now left the rotation, and in its stead - Uncle Billiard's Barbecue becomes available!
- Thunder Goober 35cm Plush (with buttcheeks) are [b]FINALLY available on my online shop[/b]!!! Get your own at [url=athenianrhapsody.com]athenianrhapsody.com[/url]

[b][u]About the Uncle Billiard's Barbecue Event[/u][/b]
Join Thunder Goober as you sail away to a rural land, where you'll be able to assemble your very own burgers alongside Uncle Billiard. This Event includes new Rhapsody customizations, a great quest and a lot of fun interactions, and several armors - one of them is even an [i]armor + weapon combo[/i] (the first one of its kind in Athenian Rhapsody).

This is the biggest Event dropped thus far - I can't wait to see what burgers you make, and how you like the Uncle Billiard fight!!! This is one of the latest animations/battles I've made using the ARhap engine, so I hope its quality reflects that.

[b][u]About the PLUSH + Rhapsody Discount[/u][/b]
Many of you have been harassing me about this for months... and finally, you can get your own! [url=https://athenianrhapsody.com/products/thunder-goober-35cm-plush]The 35cm plush[/url] looks amazing, has buttcheeks, and ships internationally!

I designed this plush myself, worked closely with manufacturers to perfect its design, organized shipping, everything on my own - this was a huge pain in the butt, but I finally have massive boxes of thunder goobers in my basement just waiting to be mailed out!

[i]When picking up a plush, [b]enjoy 20% off of all and any Rhapsodies included in your order[/b], too! Thanks so much.
[/i]
I have many, MANY things going on behind the scenes for Athenian Rhapsody right now... I'll have some great announcements for you coming in the new years - but for now, I'm just hustling on it!

notes.title: New Event - Goober's Picnic is Live!!!!
notes.content:
[h2]There's a NEW EVENT LIVE NOW in Athenian Rhapsody!!![/h2]

[h3]Event Overview:[/h3]
Goober's Picnic is now activated and ready for you to receive and play during your Rhapsodies! This Event is a small one, which allows the player to visit somewhere in Athens closest to Elysium... Here, you and Thunder Goober will share some tea while he almost completely pulls back the curtain on how this "Rhapsody System" really started...

This Event gives ALL players of all devices [b]access to the exclusive TGPD armors[/b], [b]early access to the portable camera[/b], and unifies a lot of lore that you may have pieced together or were hoping to learn. It ALSO has a [b]funny effect that carries over in-game[/b] (not IBS)

[h2]How to receive Events:[/h2]
In the main menu, head to the "Rhapsodies" menu and connect to the Online System. Once there, head to the menu where you'll find the online features such as your profile, recent trades, etc - there you will see the "Events" section where you can check for and receive this Event Rhapsody!

Once you have this Event, though it's available for download for a limited time, you will be able to play it forever.

[b][url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/7UTBnf-CF1E]Here is a skit I filmed for the launch of Goober's Picnic - please watch and enjoy![/url]
[/b]

notes.title: Upcoming Events, Merch, and Updates!
notes.content:
Dogs! Not only is this a game update, but I wanted to let you know about some awesome upcoming events, merch, and other cool [i]Athenian Rhapsonews![/i]

[h3]Game Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] One of Dynamo's capes was not obtainable by accident - defeating Dynamo will now give you a new cape as intended
[*] Fixed naming the Build-A-Boss pet after another follower which would break stuff
[*] Fixed certain button prompts not being correct on Steam Deck
[*] Fixed GirlCat's shield tracker duping
[*] [b]Made James' Close Calls Cheaper - from 50 to 25 BURST[/b]
[*] Typos and many other little minor bugs that you guys have shown me
[/list]

[h3]Merch Shop:[/h3]
I've been setting up my own website in which I will be selling merchandise of Athenian Rhapsody - that means I will be packing every order myself, and including little things like notes, previously PAX-Exclusive Thunder Goober hats, and more!!!

I'm currently working on the game's first plush, which is Thunder Goober. [url=https://linktr.ee/athenianrhapsody?utm_source=linktree_profile_share&ltsid=b72baa7c-c1f7-4449-997a-7adfc00b692e]I'll be showing off some sample products on my social medias once I receive them[/url] - this should be up and functional by late summer! The first merch drop will be a limited supply of TG plushes, and if that goes well I will create more plush, products, and expand the roster of characters included!!! Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40954853/78c3ee3175e1e0a804b8772c1bc8756d7c85d048.png[/img]

[h3]Birthday:[/h3]
[b]I just turned 25![/b] Thanks guys for all of the support and birthday wishes. My family got me this awesome Athenian Rhapsocake from Carvel. That's it! Thanks guys, working on this game and being able to grow it more and more is a dream come true!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40954853/b45937aaaa2c843be0df5be721bbd4cbb743fac6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Two Upcoming Events for 2024:[/h3]
I'm going to be releasing a new, hearty FREE Event later this summer featured around a Character many of you know, but haven't been able to experience as it's been a convention exclusive experience.

I'm also likely [b]partnering up with a great video game themed NY burger chain to bring a real-life tie in event to you guys!!![/b] Not only will you be able to play this event in-game, but North-East US Residents can actually go to this place and try menu items like the [b]Athenian Rhapsoburger[/b], [b]Thunder Goober Shake[/b], and whatever else we cook up! This will likely be around August, so stay tuned for when I drop this news...

After that, I will be releasing a large, new and expansive paid-Event which will expand on the game's lore and story. This Event will add a whole new type of Rhapsody to it as well - Arp and I have been cooking behind the scenes, and I think this is the perfect add-on that all of you guys have been wanting since some of you have hit the 80 to 100 hour mark! I can't wait, but it won't be ready until likely this fall...

I will be notifying you guys of all of these advancements individually as they come - since it's been one month exactly from launch, I wanted to give you guys a rundown of everything that's been in motion since you guys helped me make this game all I could have ever hoped. Thank you, talk soon!

notes.title: Athenian Rhapsody Update v0.96.243 - Bug Fixes, New Armors, and Accessibility!!!
notes.content:
My favorite Rhapsodogs!!! In this update, I adjusted the game's balance based on your feedback, fixed some small quirks with our first event, and even added some more rewards for it. Check it out!!!

[list]
[*] [b]Adjusted the way player's defenses scale as they level up[/b] - this way players won't feel less powerful as they gain EXP due to healing items becoming less useful in the higher levels... I'm asking for feedback on this change!!! I'd like to balance the game as much as possible.
[*] Added [b]two new armors you can receive from Dynamo[/b] depending on which way you decide to end the battle... That's[b] three different armors total[/b]!
[*] Fixed an issue where you could crash the Dynamo battle during the wire pulling minigame
[*] Fixed the joystick not working during Dynamo's minigame on Mobile
[*] Adjusted the depth of the items you carry during the restaurant scene
[*] Fixed Asmongold not returning to your party when leaving the Event halfway through
[*] Fixed some inconsistencies with certain postmarks/badges when stacked
[*] Added mobile accessibility options in the form of button placement/opacity
[/list]

I am still working on getting SteamDeck achievements working - sorry it's taken so long, as a solodev sometimes it takes me a while, especially when I can't figure out the root cause yet. Though there is no known issue, I suspect it may be a GameMaker runtime issue, I am going to be testing this out to see if that's why as nothing in my code currently indicates that this would be an issue. Sorry!

Thanks guy! Keep playing, I have some more awesome add-ons coming soon!!!

Let me know if I broke anything!

notes.title: Athenian Rhapsody's FIRST FREE DLC Crossover with OTK Games Expo!!!
notes.content:
Dogs. This is an epic moment in Athenian Rhapsody history!

In collaboration with the OTK Games Expo, Athenian Rhapsody unveils its first Event!!! Travel alongside Asmongold and friends to take on a new epic boss... Learn a little bit more about the world of Athens and its history - but for now, you may have more questions than answers after playing. Luckily, more events are planned and they will get bigger and bigger!!!

Thank you so much for the OTK team for making this possible - [b]The developer of Athenian Rhapsody is also appearing in-person during the showcase, which you can find here below:[/b] 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5uTdsnqf29s]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5uTdsnqf29s[/url]

[h2]What's an Event?[/h2]

[b]Events[/b] in Athenian Rhapsody are a special form of DLC which allows players to [b]access new places[/b] midway in their story to [b]discover new characters[/b], [b]equip new armors and gear[/b], [b]battle with new followers[/b], and [b]deck out their Rhapsodies with exclusive accolades[/b].

[h2]How do I access Events in Athenian Rhapsody?[/h2]

To access an Event Rhapsody, all you have to do is [b]connect to the online system and select the option to check for Events[/b]. You will obtain a special type of Rhapsody when an Event is active! This Event will run for the entirety of June, so anytime you log in this month you can obtain it - get it before it's gone! Once you have the Event Rhapsody, you will always be able to access the content it unlocks.

If you have an Event Rhapsody in your collection, you may access it by speaking to Thu- I mean [b]Captain Goober in Primo, on his sick motorboat[/b].

Thanks for reading! I hope you enjoy this little bit of extra content delivered in a cool, unique way that I hope is special to you guys. If it seems like you like the content of this one and the system, I'm going to create larger and bigger add-ons to this game and even introduce new types of Rhapsodies for you to stack with your existing ones and obtain. This is the first step into something that could be amazing!

[h2]Hey, one more thing![/h2]

If you have any difficulty with receiving the event, worry not as we have plenty of time to solve any issues so that everyone can receive it. This is super ambitious for my team and I, and we would appreciate all of the help and feedback we can get!

With this event being our first, we hope to refine the system so that we can do more and more in the future. Thank you!

Hello you dastardly dogs. You dastardly Rhapsodogs. Who I love very much.

I'm still working on the Steam Deck achievements thing - I think its a Linux issue, and there aren't really many people I know to ask about this in terms of GameMaker but I'm workin' on it and will have it resolved soon!!!

notes.title: Post-Launch 0.96.22 Update
notes.content:
Rhapsodogs!!! I'm so glad that so many of you are enjoying the game! I've been working hard to iron out all of the quirks, bugs, and strange happenings you guys have found. Here's a list of what's currently been patched in 0.96.22, and what's coming in future updates:

[b]What's been fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] The crash happening when being caught in the Avalanche
[*] The tea being added to the player's inventory when full
[*] Doug (not Thunder Goober) not disappearing after befriending everyone in the Tundra/Fixed All Befriended Biomes Badges/Postmark
[*] Fixed an issue where if encountering the hero but Scrut'nhaus'r was defeated, it won't be recognized
[*] The crash happening in player's Rhapsodies when their connected was Scrut'nhaus'r or GirlCat
[*] Taking Steam screenshots
[*] Chill Mode Menu crashing if you have a Munchkin and have never activated Chill Mode
[*] Nerfed Richard's Lasers
[*] The oversight where you can exit the Long Cat room early
[*] The issue when reloading after dying during the Orazio fight
[*] The overlapping text in the Franklin Balloon Fight
[*] Aerosol's achievement not unlocking during Lullaby route
[*] Steam Screenshots not registering
[*] Battles not progressing after eating the Golden Frisky
[*] "Nevermind" option not working in Main Menu object
[*] Out of bounds Horatio Basketball oversight
[*] Weird cutscene trigger outside of Athens in the cave
[*] Pause menu being re-openable after immediately closing it, allowing players to do weird stuff
[*] Shield Invincibility in Horatio fight
[*] Made the text when Richard sends the dog away clearer
[*] Two games in a row Tutorial crash
[*] Horatio Double James bug
[*] Tundra Gottheil Armor Crash
[*] Various collisions
[*] Other small oversights or minor things you found
[/list]

[b]What I'm still working on:[/b]
[list]
[*] Horatio's Basketball Hitboxes
[*] Steamdeck Achievements
[*] Potential softlock in Lullaby Route when spamming BEFRIEND
[*] Dying immediately after fighting the fly without saving or hitting an autosave can result in a softlock
[*] Standing in a weird spot during the Cattail Beach cutscene can push you out of bounds
[*] Richard's chase music won't play after death
[*] Various other small quirks, oversights, or things I didn't think you would do!
[/list]

Through you're help, I'm going to make this game AIR TIGHT!!! It's much different having thousands of you guys run through this game as compared to my few testers, thank you for your patience and help. THOUSANDS of Rhapsodies have been created thus far!!!

I'm so excited to keep growing and building this game... I have new content coming sooner than you think! Stay tuned Dogs!

notes.title: Post Launch: First Round of Patches
notes.content:
Hello Rhapsodogs - thank you for the immense support on Athenian Rhapsody through launch... This has been insane!!! This post is about the update that just went live, patching some bugs you have found. I'll be updating this post with small build changes that fix things you find!

[h3]0.96.22 Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] The crash happening when being caught in the Avalanche
[*] The tea being added to the player's inventory when full
[*] Doug (not Thunder Goober) not disappearing after befriending everyone in the Tundra/Fixed All Befriended Biomes Badges/Postmark
[*] Fixed an issue where if encountering the hero but Scrut'nhaus'r was defeated, it won't be recognized
[/list]

[h3]Emergency 0.96.21 Update[/h3]
Due to an issue, I had to update this version to 0.96.21 - if you experience a crash during the LEGEND CUTSCENES, ensure you're on this version. If you are and you are experiencing this issue or any others, PLEASE LET ME KNOW!!!

This emergency patch also fixes...
[list]
[*] The crash happening in player's Rhapsodies when their connected was Scrut'nhaus'r or GirlCat
[*] Taking Steam screenshots
[*] Chill Mode Menu crashing if you have a Munchkin and have never activated Chill Mode
[/list]

[h3]0.96.2 Update[/h3]
This update fixes...
[list]
[*] Nerfed Richard's Lasers
[*] The oversight where you can exit the Long Cat room early
[*] The issue when reloading after dying during the Orazio fight
[*] The overlapping text in the Franklin Balloon Fight
[*] Aerosol's achievement not unlocking during Lullaby route
[*] Steam Screenshots not registering
[*] Battles not progressing after eating the Golden Frisky
[*] "Nevermind" option not working in Main Menu object
[*] Out of bounds Horatio Basketball oversight
[*] Weird cutscene trigger outside of Athens in the cave
[*] Pause menu being re-openable after immediately closing it, allowing players to do weird stuff
[*] Shield Invincibility in Horatio fight
[*] Made the text when Richard sends the dog away clearer
[*] Two games in a row Tutorial crash
[*] Horatio Double James bug
[*] Tundra Gottheil Armor Crash
[*] Various collisions
[*] Other small oversights or minor things you found
[/list]

Things I'm still working on...
[list]
[*] Horatio's Basketball Hitboxes
[*] Steamdeck Achievements
[*] Potential softlock in Lullaby Route when spamming BEFRIEND
[*] Dying immediately after fighting the fly without saving or hitting an autosave can result in a softlock
[*] Standing in a weird spot during the Cattail Beach cutscene can push you out of bounds
[*] Richard's chase music won't play after death
[/list]

[b]Please let me know[/b] if anything is now broken, you cannot progress, or any other change was made that was not intended and I will roll it back and fix it - Thank you for all of your reports, and happy Rhapsody chasing!!!

[i]The Playfab servers were also reportedly down momentarily but should be working again![/i]

notes.title: Tokyo Game Show 2022 - And A New Demo!
notes.content:
Athenian Rhapsody has the awesome privilege of being shown off at [b]Tokyo Game Show 2022[/b], alongside the [b]release of an updated demo[/b]! A lot of work has went into this event for the past month, and my team and I are extremely excited to finally share it with you. Thank you to you guys for creating an amazing community around Athenian Rhapsody and supporting it for the past year.

The updated demo is the same snipbit of content as the prior one, except with one full year of updates under its belt. In this demo, you'll be able to experience:
[list]
[*] Activation of [b]New Routes[/b]
[*] A [b]New Secret Boss[/b]
[*] Heavily [b]Updated Gameplay[/b]
[*] The [b]Final Title Screen[/b]
[*] Generally a [b]better experience[/b] with Athenian Rhapsody, and more representative of how the final game will look and feel.
[*] [strike]All instances of [b]Cattail have been removed[/b] from the game.[/strike]
[/list]
I'm so excited for you all to play it that I am genuinely freaking out, whether it's your first or third time playing through the demo there's something new for you to look forward to. There are some real challenges, and a few suspicious events that you may discover along your path...

Discuss your experience, and follow ARhap's other social medias here on my [url=https://linktr.ee/athenianrhapsody]linktree![/url]
